purpose: The stable interface between this runtime image and the tasks that own submission, adapters, the scientific controller, Kueue queues, Terraform and the admin surface. Those tasks consume this document. This task does not edit their files.

image.repository_note: The concrete registry account path is a deployment binding supplied at deploy time and is deliberately not committed. The immutable digest is the authoritative identity.
image.qualification_required: The repaired r7 successor is published and protocol-compatible, but it requires exact-digest H100 parameter-load and inference qualification before activation.
image.digest_note: This is the authoritative identity; consume the image by digest. Do not substitute sha256:eaea560ce2ddba8d828371d1cba01da954d9a68ff5e77ba4d43b36b107141887 or sha256:bead2e68627c1aa7d5fa80243b1164a18160f48cf3a1867090d72ff2b9270e37, which are stock upstream images retained only as historical semantic evidence and are not this runtime.
image.gpu_requirement: Any NVIDIA GPU of compute capability 8.0 or later. Compute capability 8.0+ is required by the default Triton and cuDNN flash-attention kernels; --flash-attention xla removes that requirement. No node name, GPU model or H100-specific selector is baked into the image or into any reusable contract.

superseded.reason: Consumed an invented reference receipt shape. Must not be deployed.
PASS receipt before upstream exited, whole-root reference mount undetected, stage-critical flags reachable through --extra-arg. Must not be deployed.
Extra-argument denylist bypassable through Abseil --flagfile, and a handoff carrying absolute producer paths. Must not be deployed.
Runtime semantics were accepted, but its SLSA attestation named commit 2ddba5fe, which was amended away, so its provenance pointed at source that no longer matched the image. Must not be deployed.
Its retained H100 semantics predate the repaired atomic terminal receipt, bounded handoff, frozen invocation identity, and shared workspace identity protocol. Must not be deployed.

image.provenance_note: The SLSA attestation records vcs:revision a1b5b6b24b2dae54a1f7caeba9981a7aaa60cc8f, the exact clean pushed commit this image was built from. The build fails if those ever disagree.

modes.verify: Identity and hygiene only. No GPU, no parameters required. Safe as an init container or a readiness gate.
modes.smoke: Imports the installed distribution, asserts version 3.0.4, and reports visible JAX devices. No parameters required.
modes.params-load: Verifies the parameter identity then loads it through the upstream official loader. This is the GPU semantic check.
modes.data: CPU preprocessing stage. Requires the publisher receipt, the mounted published tree and the frozen thread count. Adds --norun_inference plus both MSA thread flags.
modes.inference: GPU inference stage. Requires verified parameters and the CPU handoff JSON. Adds --norun_data_pipeline.
modes.plan: Composes and prints a stage's argv without executing it. Requires --stage.

exit_codes.2: a binding, identity or stage-separation requirement was not met; a FAIL receipt is emitted
exit_codes.other: the exit code of run_alphafold.py, passed through unchanged

mounts.name: reference-data
mounts.mount_path_rule: The reference root is mounted read-only at /reference-data and the per-revision database_root is derived from the receipt, so no snapshot identity is ever hand-assembled.

mounts.name: output
mounts.note: Holds the immutable handoff JSON the GPU stage consumes.

mounts.name: scratch
mounts.note: HOME and TMPDIR. Per-pod, not shared.

stages.produces: AlphaFold 3 data-pipeline output JSON plus the reference manifest digests recorded in the receipt

handoff_publication.terminal_receipt: temp file, file fsync, atomic rename, directory fsync
handoff_publication.memory_reasoning: At most about 511 MiB is resident while the collector holds validated content and its canonical tar; the artifact sidecar has 2 GiB.

reference_receipt.binding: the mounted directory's full name equals content.tree_sha256 and the tree's .fs2-manifest-sha256 marker equals content.manifest_sha256
reference_receipt.transform_output: reference_data {bundle_id, revision, manifest_uri, manifest_sha256}, with the manifest URI supplied by the caller

cpu_envelope.driven_by: the controller-frozen thread count, matching backend.threads

mounts.name: handoff
mounts.note: The immutable output of the CPU data stage.

mounts.name: compiler-cache
mounts.note: Persistent auxiliary XLA and Triton compilation cache. Optional: an unwritable or absent cache degrades to an uncached run, reported truthfully in the receipt.

stages.produces: structure and confidence outputs under the output mount

pod_security.supplemental_groups_reason: The academic claim delivers the parameter object as mode 0440 group 65532, and access is by supplemental group.
pod_security.fs_group_reason: fsGroup rewrites the delivered modes to 0660/2775, which would make licensed bytes group writable and broadly readable.
pod_security.readOnlyRootFilesystem: supported; every writable path the runtime needs is a mount

environment.FS2_AF3_FLASH_ATTENTION: triton by default; xla for portability across GPU families
environment.override_rule: Environment variables move paths only. Expected digests, sizes and versions come from the contracts baked into the image and cannot be weakened by pod configuration.
environment.FS2_AF3_REFERENCE_RECEIPT: path to the producer-generated terminal receipt
environment.FS2_AF3_THREADS: controller-frozen MSA thread count for the CPU stage
environment.FS2_AF3_CPU_REQUEST: the CPU stage's CPU request, used to reject oversubscription
environment.FS2_AF3_REFERENCE_MANIFEST: optional localized manifest document, whose canonical digest is recomputed when given

asserts: the mounted object's SHA-256 and size equal the authorized parameter identity
the model directory exposes exactly one selectable parameter object

expected_reference_values.provenance: Retained evidence from the historical stock upstream image. A cross-check, not evidence for this image.

cache_levels.L1: image-local: AlphaFold 3 source, python environment, HMMER, Chemical Component Dictionary derived data
cache_levels.auxiliary_compiler_cache: /cache/alphafold3 holds XLA and Triton compilation artefacts only
cache_levels.rule: No L2 or higher level and no GPU snapshot may be claimed for this runtime without measured evidence produced by the fast-start qualification task.

blocking: the exact published r7 digest passes H100 parameter-load and inference semantic qualification
reference-data worker publishes the AlphaFold 3 bundle and generates its terminal receipt for a real CPU data stage
controller route and submission wiring landed by their owning tasks
readiness.rule: The r7 runtime is published and production-protocol compatible, but AlphaFold 3 is not servable until r7 semantic H100 qualification, the reference bundle, and the controller route land.
completed: runtime image built from a clean committed source revision, with SPDX and SLSA provenance whose vcs:revision equals that commit, proven free of licensed and reference-database payload by a layer walk, and published to the project registry by immutable digest
historical r6 H100 semantic evidence is retained only as a cross-check; it is not qualification evidence for the r7 digest

command_io_contract.note: The single supported command surface for data and inference. There is no fs2-run-alphafold3 entrypoint; an adapter targeting it cannot invoke this image.
